title: Information Assurance Governance
description: Organizations shall establish information assurance governance with defined accountability

title: Information Security Risk Assessment
description: Information security risks shall be identified evaluated treated and reviewed periodically

title: Information Asset Inventory
description: Information assets shall be identified classified and assigned accountable ownership

title: User Access Management
description: Logical access shall follow least privilege need-to-know and periodic access review requirements

title: Qatar Data Residency
description: Restricted or regulated information shall remain within Qatar or approved national hosting environments where required

title: Security Audit Logging
description: System activities and security-relevant events shall be logged retained and monitored

title: Arabic Compliance Records
description: Compliance and audit records shall be available in Arabic when required by national authorities

title: National CERT Notification
description: Reportable cybersecurity incidents shall be notified to the national cybersecurity authority or CERT within required timelines

title: Third-Party Assurance
description: Suppliers shall be evaluated for security risk and bound by contractual information assurance requirements

title: Information Service Recovery
description: Recovery procedures shall be maintained tested and aligned with business impact requirements

title: Approved Local Hosting
description: Regulated services shall use local or nationally approved hosting environments where mandated

title: Vulnerability Remediation
description: Vulnerabilities shall be identified prioritized and remediated according to risk and exposure
